description.value:
Activation: As a Bonus Action while you are Bloodied. At 3rd Class Mod level, you can activate the seal without being Bloodied. The seal remains active for 1 minute.

  • Gain +2 AC, +30 feet of movement, and +3 to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws.
  • At 4th Class Mod level, these bonuses become +3 AC, +60 feet of movement, and +5 to those saving throws.
  • D-, C-, B-, A-, and S-Rank jutsu cost 3/5/7/11/15 chakra while the seal is active, unless their normal or Special cost is lower.
  • Gain 20 Kāma Points per Class Mod level as stacking temporary hit points. Speed Type grants 10 per level and White Kāma grants 15 per level.
  • Each activation automatically adds 5 Divine Rewrite.
  • The selected Seal Type and its automatic 3rd-level evolution are included in this Active Effect.

Controls: Use the “Kāma” button on the character sheet or run N5eBClassMods.toggleKama(actor).

source.custom: Kāma - Divine Power Class Mod v2.0

description.value:
Once per turn while your Kāma is active, you may elevate one jutsu you cast into a Divine Art.

  • Divine Art Save DC = 10 + half your character level + your proficiency bonus.
  • Divine Art Attack Bonus = half your character level + your Kāma Seal level + your proficiency bonus.
  • For non-d20 dice, add 2 dice or increase the total ranks of a condition by 2.
  • Alternatively, increase DR by 5, AC by 2, temporary hit points by 15, speed by 60 feet, teleport distance by 30 feet, or the attack roll/save DC by 1.

source.custom: Kāma - Divine Power Class Mod v2.0

description.value:
Resonance Disruption is tracked by the dedicated Kāma Tracking panel rather than item uses.

Your first Kāma activation after a Full Rest adds 2 ranks. Each later activation adds one additional rank. A Long Rest removes 1 rank; the tracker’s Full Rest control removes 2 ranks and resets the escalating activation count.

RankCumulative Drawback
1Reduce attack rolls, save DCs, and saving throws by 1 per rank.
2Reduce AC by an additional 3.
3Increase jutsu costs by 2 per rank.
4You cannot maintain concentration on jutsu or features.
5At the end of each turn, roll 1d6. On a 1, you are Incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

description.value:
Your DNA is permanently rewritten into an Ōtsutsuki form. Divine Rewrite starts at 0 and normally cannot decrease, even if you lose this Class Mod.

Each activation of the Kāma Seal automatically adds 5 Divine Rewrite, to a maximum of 100. Track the value with the dedicated Kāma Tracking panel on the character sheet or the tracker button in the sheet header.

The module grants only the highest milestone reached. At 30 Divine Rewrite, Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution—and their maximums—increase by 2.

description.value:

  • Use up to half of the Ōtsutsuki’s known jutsu of each rank, provided you meet their keyword requirements. You cannot cast more than one rank above your normal limit.
  • Gain the Ōtsutsuki’s skill proficiencies and masteries. If both of you are proficient in the same skill, gain +3 instead.
  • Gain +2 to attack rolls and save DCs.
  • Halve the Downtime required for training.

description.value:
While your Kāma is active, you can absorb chakra. Chakra absorbed beyond your maximum becomes Temporary Chakra, up to 10 × your Class Mod level, and lasts for 8 hours. Twisted Chakra is halved.

The three embedded Absorption actions have separate roll buttons. You can use Absorption only once per round in total.

description.value:
Spend 15 chakra as an Action to create a portal to a known location within 100 miles. The portal remains open for up to 1 hour. For every additional 5 chakra spent, increase the range by 100 miles. Once the range reaches at least 500 miles, the portal can lead to another dimension.

Partially known destinations require a d100 roll. Under the source rules, a result of 25 or higher can send the portal to a random location; each major piece of reliable information increases the failure threshold by 25.

At the end of each turn, make a Charisma saving throw against DC 35. Reduce the DC by 5 for each 25% of your maximum chakra you currently have. Possession ends when your chakra is full or after 1 minute at the latest.

The Kāma Class Mod permanently alters its bearer and binds them to the power of an Ōtsutsuki. Drag this entry onto a character, then advance its Class Mod level through the standard N5eB Advancement system.

LevelRecommended Character LevelKarmic InfluencesMinimum Divine RewriteFeatures
1400Kāma Seal, Divine Arts, Seal Type, Influence, Divine Rewrite, Resonance Disruption
